_help: Site settings. Edit on GitHub and commit; Vercel redeploys in about a minute and visitors get the change on their next page load. See README.md 'Site settings' for what each setting does and how to switch things off quickly.

prices._help: Published labor prices in US dollars: numbers only, no quotes or $ sign (e.g. 60 or 1.79). The bathtub price is always 30% less than showerEach. Every page, the chat, the estimate and admin quotes use these.

estimates._help: How many days the prices on an estimate or quote PDF are held, as a whole number (e.g. 30), or null. While it is null the PDFs print no 'prices held until' date. The owner decides this; see README 'Site settings'.
